scope: ME5 guard prerequisite: separate attached-Energy selection for damage calculation from ordinary post-damage physical discard. No new whole-card support.

ruleReferences.usedFor: Ancient Bulwark official FAQ: Inferno X with three Fire Energy can damage when selecting one Energy to discard, because damage calculation precedes the attack-effect discard; Leaf Charge and Gaia Impact likewise evaluate damage before ordinary Energy changes. Generic ordinary discard timing is applied to matching existing attack programs. Bastiodon itself remains unsupported until live attacker filtering and source position are separately implemented and verified.

Official Energy-unit discard rulings: one Double Colorless may satisfy a two-Energy discard; two Double Colorless cards may also each contribute one unit. Physical cards remain indivisible. Applied to fixed-number optional damage bonuses, while explicit Energy-card counts remain CARDS.
